fp_algolia_docsearch_config.js.note: Algolia DocSearch appId/apiKey/indexName plus Typesense and Meilisearch search-only keys; all search-scoped and public by design.

fp_analytics_public_keys.js.note: Segment writeKey, Sentry DSN, Stripe pk_live_, Mapbox pk., GA4 measurementId, Amplitude key and a Meta Pixel EAA-shaped consent blob.

fp_angular_i18n_messages.js.note: Angular message catalogue keyed on password/passwd/pwd/confirmPassword/errors.password/auth.token/apiKey whose values are English sentences.

fp_esbuild_debug_ids.js.note: esbuild output with Sentry _sentryDebugIds UUIDs, a //# debugId= marker and a //# sourceMappingURL= line.

fp_firebase_public_config.js.note: Firebase web config (apiKey/authDomain/projectId/storageBucket/messagingSenderId/appId), a reCAPTCHA site key and a VAPID public key.

fp_identifier_soup_prefixes.js.note: Provider prefixes buried inside longer runs: AIza+35 and sk-proj- and ya29. inside base64url blobs, prefixes inside mangled identifiers, a ghp_-shaped id with a broken CRC32 tail, dapi/key-/v1. wrapped digests, a Discord-bot-shaped chunk-graph key and an fw_ handle next to the word fireworks.

fp_inline_base64_assets.js.note: Inlined data: URIs (PNG, SVG, WOFF2) plus base64 that decodes to JSON, to a JWKS document, to an English sentence, and a zero-filled PCM buffer that encodes as a long run of 'A'.

fp_inline_script_tag.js.note: Server-rendered inline <script> body: CSP nonce, sha256/sha384 script hashes, publishable keys, CSRF token, session and request UUIDs, plus a JSON-LD block.

fp_msw_mock_handlers.js.note: Mock Service Worker handlers that survived tree-shaking. The provider tokens in the mock response bodies are fabricated test data bound to credential-shaped keys (access_token, token, apiKey). CURRENTLY REPORTS FINDINGS - see README.

fp_nextjs_app_router_chunk.js.note: Next.js app-router chunk: __next_f flight rows, buildId, Vercel deploymentId, build manifest, server-action ids and request/correlation UUIDs.

fp_observability_trace_ids.js.note: OpenTelemetry, Datadog RUM clientToken/applicationId and a LaunchDarkly client-side id, with traceId/spanId/requestId/correlationId and W3C traceparent headers.

fp_placeholder_values.js.note: Setup-wizard defaults: YOUR_API_KEY, REPLACE_ME, xxxxxxxx runs, repeated 'a' and '0' runs, sequential hex, an AKIA prefix over a repeated body, and connection URIs whose password is changeme/notset/${DB_PASSWORD}.

fp_regex_literals.js.note: Client-side log redactor: credential-shaped text inside regex literals, /\//g style patterns, a PEM banner held as a format constant, and sensitive query-key patterns.

fp_sourcemap_recovered_ts.js.note: TypeScript recovered from sourcesContent, ending in an inline //# sourceMappingURL=data:...;base64 line that carries an AIza-shaped run inside the map payload.

fp_supabase_anon_client.js.note: Supabase browser client whose anon key is a JWT with a {"role":"anon"} payload, shipped alongside the project URL as the vendor documents.

fp_svg_css_unicode_tables.js.note: SVG path data, emotion CSS-in-JS class registry and keyframe names, @font-face unicode ranges, emoji shortcode table and ZWJ sequences.

fp_twilio_shaped_ids.js.note: Twilio resource SIDs bound to accountSid/apiKeySid/messagingServiceSid etc: AC+32hex, SK+32hex and the other two-letter SID prefixes, none of which grants access.

fp_vite_assets_integrity.js.note: Vite/Rollup manifest with assets/index-DmX9vQ2s.js style names, sha384 SRI integrity values, contentHash, etag, revision and buildId.

fp_vue3_validation_messages.js.note: Vue 3 + vee-validate field and error catalogue keyed on password/confirmPassword/errors.password/auth.token/apiKey/secret with sentence values.

fp_webpack_runtime_hashes.js.note: webpack 5 runtime chunk: chunk-id to contentHash map, module-id map, SRI table, key-<md5> cache index, <md5>-us1 regional keys and a v1.<sha1> app version.

tp_aws_access_key.js.note: Server env block inlined by define(); AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID shipped to the browser.

tp_azure_storage_key.js.note: Full Azure Blob connection string with AccountKey=; the 88-char body decodes to exactly 64 bytes, which is what the validator checks.

tp_braintree_access_token.js.note: Gateway access token used where a per-shopper client token belongs.

tp_db_connection_uri.js.note: Four connection URIs (two postgresql sharing one password, one mongodb+srv, one amqps) with passwords that survive the placeholder validator; the shared password dedupes to a single finding.

tp_generic_api_key.js.note: Generic apiKey assignment. No curated registry rule covers a bare provider-less key, by design (see the rules_ext.go header), so this case pins the legacy regex map instead: assert on matches[] rather than findings[]. Two legacy patterns match the same span and the surviving key is picked by Go map iteration order, so the assertion has to accept either name.

tp_openrouter_key.js.note: Model gateway key in an Authorization: Bearer header built in the browser.

tp_plaid_access_token.js.note: Exchanged Plaid access token cached client-side; access-production- prefix keeps it out of the sandbox/test exposure class.

tp_private_key_pem.js.note: RSA PEM block with a real BEGIN/END pair and a body, so the banner-without-body suppression does not apply. A PUBLIC KEY block sits next to it and must not fire.

tp_slack_webhook.js.note: Incoming-webhook URL posted to directly from the browser. Bound to SLACK_WEBHOOK_SECRET: a URL-shaped value needs a credential-named binding to survive the path-like shape test.

tp_supabase_service_role.js.note: Service-role JWT in an admin bundle. Payload decodes to {"role":"service_role"}, which is what separates it from the anon key in fp_supabase_anon_client.js.
